remarks:
Welcome to 10 Chase Street in Westfield, NY, a home where timeless character, gracious living spaces, and a wonderful village setting come together. Tucked among mature trees and beautiful landscaping, this three-bedroom residence offers warmth, charm, and an inviting sense of home.

Step inside to beautiful wood floors, classic details, and abundant natural light. The first floor welcomes you with a spacious entry, first floor bedroom with on-suite, half bath, formal dining room, kitchen, first-floor laundry, and two separate family rooms. The kitchen offers generous cabinetry with eat-in options, while the formal dining room sets the stage for memorable meals and gatherings. The two family rooms provide lovely spaces to relax, entertain, or simply enjoy the character of this special home.

Upstairs, two additional bedrooms each offer convenient bathroom access. One features a full bathroom, while the other has a private half bath. Throughout the home, hardwood floors, tile, large windows, and classic architectural details create a warm and timeless atmosphere.

A huge basement provides abundant storage and utility space, while the attached garage adds everyday convenience. Outside, the beautifully landscaped backyard unfolds beneath mature trees, with a covered rear deck overlooking the grounds—an ideal setting for morning coffee, afternoon gatherings, or quiet evenings outdoors.

Adding another layer of charm is the property's connection to Westfield history. According to a historical account, this land was once part of the Alfred Patterson homestead. Edgar Welch purchased the Patterson estate in 1914, and the property was later divided and developed. The Welch brothers went on to build notable homes in Westfield, including this Chase Street home completed in 1955. Today, 10 Chase Street carries that story forward as a distinctive Westfield residence.

Just a short walk from downtown Westfield, this property offers the rare combination of village convenience, generous outdoor space, beautiful original character, and a floor plan designed for comfortable living.
